description: Not sure if that message is legit? Jacana Scam Check analyzes suspicious texts, emails, and DMs to identify common fraud tactics. Paste the message and get a clear risk assessment with specific red flags and recommended next steps. You can also check a website, phone number, or email address before you trust it. Helps protect you from phishing, advance-fee fraud, impersonation, and other scams. https://hellojacana.com
